mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, payload, secret_payload, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, payload, secret_payload, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, s.uuid, #{params.SessionExternalID}, #{params.ResourceType}, CAST(#{params.Payload,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.SecretPayload,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} FROM sessions s WHERE s.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM session_resources WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND payload IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC

SELECT resource.path FROM session_resources resource CROSS JOIN (VALUES (CAST(#{params.EntryPath} AS text))) AS candidate(path) WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND resource.session_uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND resource.payload IS NOT NULL AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( resource.path = candidate.path OR left(resource.path, length(candidate.path) + 1) = concat(candidate.path, '/') OR left(candidate.path, length(resource.path) + 1) = concat(resource.path, '/') ) ORDER BY resource.path LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, payload, secret_payload, path, parent_path, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.ResourceUUID}, #{params.ResourceExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, session.uuid, session.external_id, 'directory', NULL, NULL, #{params.EntryPath}, #{params.ParentPath}, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} FROM sessions session WHERE session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND session.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND session.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id

WITH inserted_file AS ( INSERT INTO files ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, filename, mime_type, detected_mime_type, size_bytes, metadata, authorization_metadata, tags, downloadable, md5, sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, s3_etag, s3_version_id, scope_type, scope_id, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at ) SELECT #{params.FileUUID}, #{params.FileExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Filename}, #{params.MediaType}, #{params.DetectedMimeType}, #{params.SizeBytes}, CAST(#{params.Metadata} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.AuthorizationMetadata} AS jsonb), #{params.Tags}, #{params.Downloadable}, #{params.MD5}, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, #{params.S3ETag}, #{params.S3VersionID}, 'session', session.external_id, COALESCE(api_key.uuid, session.created_by_api_key_uuid), #{params.Now} FROM sessions session LEFT JOIN api_keys api_key ON api_key.uuid = #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID} AND api_key.workspace_uuid = session.workspace_uuid WHERE session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND session.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND session.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING uuid ) INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, payload, secret_payload, path, parent_path, file_uuid, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.ResourceUUID}, #{params.ResourceExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, session.uuid, session.external_id, 'file', NULL, NULL, #{params.EntryPath}, #{params.ParentPath}, inserted_file.uuid, #{params.ExpiresAt}, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} FROM inserted_file JOIN sessions session ON session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} RETURNING id
